filename: T2 - Clear cell meningioma cerebellopontine angle , ventricle 007.jpg
description: A left cerebellopontine angle heterogeneous lobulated mass with multiple cystic components. Signs of calcification on SWI present. The mass exerts mass effect in the form of compression of the 4th ventricle and compression of the brain stem.
